items.title: Security Council, 10242nd Meeting (AM) Libya
items.summary: The Security Council today will hold its 60-day briefing on the situation in Libya. Hanna Serwaa Tetteh, Special Representative of the Secretary-General and Head of the United Nations Support Mission in Libya (UNSMIL), will brief members on recent political, security and humanitarian developments. The 15-member organ is also expected to renew UNSMIL’s mandate, which expires on 31 October.

items.title: Security Council, 10241st Meeting (AM) Haiti
items.summary: The Security Council will vote on a draft resolution to extend the sanctions regime on Haiti. The regime, which was established in 2022 and includes a travel ban, asset freeze and arms embargo, was last renewed on 17 October 2025 with the adoption of resolution 2794 (2025).
